rationale: The agent canceled the order immediately without authenticating the user or confirming the action, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. The user first asked about splitting payment, then about removing the most expensive item or switching to cheaper options, and only as a last resort to cancel the entire order; the agent did not explore or explain these options. Additionally, the agent stated specific details (refund amount, card ending digits, processing time) without any visible tool-based verification in the conversation and provided an arguably incorrect cancellation reason (“ordered by mistake”). Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
